name: ResNet-Based CT Reconstruction
definition: Uses a ResNet neural network to map noisy filtered backprojection (FBP) reconstructions directly to ground truth images, learning to suppress artifacts and noise.
summary: ResNet-Based CT Reconstruction is a learned post-processing method that maps noisy filtered backprojection images to clean ground truth, distinguished by using acquisition geometry physics to guide denoising rather than conditioning on the explicit Radon matrix.
